_note: Every interface label. Urdu and Pashto drafted by the team and pending a native-speaker review. {placeholders} are filled in by js/app.js.

en.tap_district: Tap a district on the map or in the list.
en.tap_uc: Tap a union council for its ten-day chart and CSV.
en.legend_green: Rain covered what the crops needed
en.legend_nodata: No cropland mapped, or a source was missing
en.legend_note: Deficit is the water crops needed minus the rain they received over ten days, across {basis}. It describes a whole union council.
en.layer_note: Hectares from ESA WorldCover 2021, shaded by rank within this district.
en.status_sentence: {ha} ha of {basis} lie under this signal.
en.rule_green: Rule: rain was at least what the crops needed.
en.rule_amber: Rule: deficit of 1 to {max} mm, which one irrigation turn covers.
en.rule_red: Rule: deficit above {max} mm, more than one irrigation turn.
en.nodata_no_crop: No cropland was mapped here, so no water balance is computed.
en.nodata_missing: A source was missing for this period.
en.trend_up: The deficit has grown {n} ten-day periods in a row.
en.trend_up_one: The deficit grew since the previous ten days.
en.trend_flat: The deficit did not grow since the previous ten days.
en.no_series: No time series for this unit yet.
en.crop_type_notice: Winter cereals, maize and irrigated area need ESA WorldCereal through Earth Engine. They are reported as unavailable rather than estimated.
